title: Listen and Say First Sounds
summary: Connect a few first Kreyòl words and short phrases with what you hear, then say the same targets aloud using transcript-based speaking practice.

sketchBlocks.title: Let the full word come before analysis
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
When a new language is unfamiliar, it is tempting to break every word into English-looking pieces. Instead, listen to the **whole Kreyòl word**, then connect it with the spelling you already saw.

Use these anchors:

- **bonjou**
- **mèsi**
- **wi**
- **non**

Replay when needed. The goal is recognition, not speed.

sketchBlocks.title: Use the written target as your speaking guide
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
For speaking practice, read the complete target once, then say it naturally. The activity compares the **speech transcript** with the authored Kreyòl target. It is not a phoneme-by-phoneme pronunciation score.

Keep the word intact. For example, when you see **mèsi**, preserve the word as one unit instead of spelling it aloud letter by letter.

sketchBlocks.title: Hear words together
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Once a single word feels familiar, listen to two words together. A short phrase such as **Wi, mèsi.** lets you hear familiar Kreyòl without adding much new vocabulary.

Listen first, rebuild what you heard, then say the same phrase. This creates a direct path from sound → written Kreyòl → spoken Kreyòl.

quizDraft.title: Recognize bonjou
quizDraft.prompt: Which spelling matches the Kreyòl greeting you heard in this lesson?
quizDraft.hint: Look for the spelling feature practiced in this lesson.

help.concept: Kreyòl spelling keeps meaningful vowel and sound patterns visible in the written word.
help.hint_1: Focus on the spelling pattern named in the lesson instead of applying English spelling habits.
help.hint_2: Compare the letters and accent marks carefully before choosing your response.

quizDraft.title: Complete bonjou
quizDraft.prompt: Choose the pattern that completes the Kreyòl greeting.
quizDraft.hint: Use the sound-spelling pattern from the lesson to complete the word.

help.concept: Kreyòl spelling keeps meaningful vowel and sound patterns visible in the written word.
help.hint_1: Focus on the spelling pattern named in the lesson instead of applying English spelling habits.
help.hint_2: Compare the letters and accent marks carefully before choosing your response.

quizDraft.title: Hear a short phrase
quizDraft.prompt: Listen, then build the two-word phrase.
quizDraft.hint: Replay the audio, then rebuild exactly what you hear.

help.concept: Listening practice connects the complete written Kreyòl phrase with the phrase you hear.
help.hint_1: Replay the phrase and keep the words in the same order.
help.hint_2: Listen for the whole word or phrase rather than trying to translate each sound into English spelling.

quizDraft.title: Say bonjou
quizDraft.prompt: Say the Kreyòl greeting shown: Bonjou.
quizDraft.hint: Read the Kreyòl target once, then say the whole phrase.

help.concept: Speaking practice checks the transcript of the phrase you say against the authored Kreyòl target.
help.hint_1: Say the complete target phrase clearly at a comfortable pace.
help.hint_2: Use the written Kreyòl as your guide; this activity checks the transcript, not a phoneme-level pronunciation score.

quizDraft.title: Build thank you, Mom
quizDraft.prompt: Arrange the Kreyòl words to make “Thank you, Mom.”
quizDraft.hint: Build the complete Kreyòl phrase in natural order.

help.concept: Sentence building uses the same Kreyòl word order and spelling that appear in the target phrase.
help.hint_1: Start with the phrase you recognize, then place the remaining word or punctuation in its natural position.
help.hint_2: Read the complete result aloud once before checking it.

quizDraft.title: Write non
quizDraft.prompt: Type the Kreyòl word for “no” used in this lesson.
quizDraft.hint: Write the Kreyòl form exactly as it appears in the lesson.

help.concept: Accurate Kreyòl writing preserves the spelling patterns and meaningful accent marks shown in the lesson.
help.hint_1: Write the complete Kreyòl form, including any accent mark that belongs in the word.
help.hint_2: Check the vowel spelling one more time before submitting.
